articles.summary: Toronto, October 13, 2026 – Highlander Silver Corp. (TSX, NYSE American: HSLV) (“Highlander Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to report on a recent meeting with President Keiko Fujimori and Minister of Energy and Mines Guillermo Shinno Huamaní in Lima.
articles.title: Highlander Silver Welcomed by President Keiko Fujimori of Peru
